label: BUG
title: Saving a rule silently overwrites a change made by someone else

panels.caption: Rules list after admin A saved: the rename made meanwhile in another tab is gone, no warning was shown

rows: Rule renamed in tab 2 while open in tab 1, then tab 1 saves
Tab 1 is told the rule changed and asked to reload; nothing is lost.
Save succeeds with no warning; the rename is lost (name back to the old one). The save carries no version, so the server cannot detect it.
